# Urban Outfitters

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 9 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Fashion storefront: white page, #222 ink, Helvetica 12px chrome, square black buy button, red sale price, green promo line, promo strip, sign-in dialog.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing pages and the sign-in dialog only; no phone, email, bag, or card was entered). Themes: light.

A token set for Urban Outfitters' public signed-out storefront, for building a fashion shop in that style. Values were read from urbanoutfitters.com on 2026-11-19 and checked again on 2026-11-22, signed out, in the T3 preview browser. Desktop CSS viewport 1440 by 900, phone CSS viewport 390 by 844, both at devicePixelRatio 2. Pages photographed: home, the Women's mega-menu, the women's clothing grid, one product page, search, the empty bag, and the empty sign-in and create-account dialogs. No account was created. Nothing was added to bag. Checkout was not entered. `/login` stopped at a captcha wall, which was not solved and not saved.

The storefront is white, with `#222222` ink, Helvetica at 12px for chrome, square controls, a black cart button, red sale prices, and green promo lines. The first promo slide is a measured red (`#eb4034`) that is not a custom property.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

**Helvetica** (with Arial, then sans-serif) is the computed body face on nav, prices, buttons, and headings. Weights measured: 100 on the product title, 400 on chrome, 700 on the cart and Next buttons. **MonoSpec** is a site `@font-face` (woff2 on static.urbanoutfitters.com) named by `--font-body-small`. Neither face is distributed here. The style guide uses Helvetica.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Viewport shots, not full-page stitches.** [screenshots/](screenshots/) shows the first screen of each page. The women's grid reports a scroll height near 20,000px and was not tiled.
- **One theme.** No dark switch was on the pages that were measured. There is no dark token set.
- **Promo red is computed, not declared.** `#eb4034` is the first slide's background. Later slides use `#222222`. Do not treat the red as a permanent brand token.
- **Hover and disabled colours are authored.** They resolve from `--button-*-hover` and `--button-*-disabled`. A live hover repaint was not captured, because synthetic mouse events did not change computed colour.
- **`--drop-shadow` has no measured offset.** Visible chrome computed `box-shadow: none`.
- **`--rewards-progress-bar-background` is `rgb(#eee)`.** That value is invalid as read. It is not tokenised.
- **MonoSpec** is declared for `--font-body-small` and was not seen on the measured chrome. Helvetica was the computed face.
- **Geo.** The sign-in country select showed dialing code 65. Prices were USD. Locale was not changed.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do keep the shop white and the ink `#222222`.** Chrome, tiles, and the dialog sit on `#ffffff`. Muted copy is `#707070`. Hairlines are `#dddddd`. See [screenshots/home-desktop-viewport.png](screenshots/home-desktop-viewport.png).
2. **Do keep controls square.** Nav, search, cart, size chips, and the dialog are 0px radius. The country select is the measured exception at 5px, and swatches are circles.
3. **Do use black for the buy button.** The cart button and Next are `#222222` with white bold 16px type. Hover, from the stylesheet, is `#707070`.
4. **Do use red only for the sale price and green only for the promo line.** Sale computed `#d83604`. Promo copy computed `#3a8700`.
5. **Do set chrome type at 12px Helvetica with 0.5px tracking.** Product titles go to 22px at weight 100.
6. **Don't invent a dark theme.** None was offered on the measured pages.
7. **Don't round the product tiles.** They have no border and no shadow.
8. **Don't treat the promo-strip red as the brand accent.** `#eb4034` was the first slide only. Later slides were `#222222`.
